movie.title: Bible Black
movie.overview: Minase, a high school student, found a magic book in a secluded room at his school. He began practicing black magic, which has extreme sexual effects that benefit him and some of his friends. Intrigued, Minase delved deeper into the art, unaware of the evils that lay ahead. Eventually, the book's origins were revealed, as well as the incident that occurred twelve years earlier on Walpurgis Night, the night when the power of evil is at its strongest. After regaining his senses, Minase struggles to escape the darkness he had plunged into.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: After discovering an ancient grimoire hidden in his high school, a student becomes entangled in dark magic and dangerous occult conspiracies.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: High school student Yuuki Minase discovers a forgotten magic book hidden in a secluded area of his school. Driven by curiosity, he begins experimenting with black magic to gain power and influence over those around him. However, as he delves deeper into the occult rituals, he triggers sinister forces tied to a dark event from twelve years prior. Realizing the grave danger he has brought upon himself and his peers, Minase must find a way to break free from the dark magic before it consumes him entirely.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Yuuki Minase, an ordinary high school student, stumbles upon a mysterious grimoire tucked away in a closed-off room within his academy. Intrigued by the book's contents, he begins practicing dark magical rituals, quickly realizing that the spells exert a potent influence over others. As Minase continues to explore the book's capabilities, a secret society within the school faculty and student body begins to manipulate events from the shadows. Unbeknownst to Minase, the book is inextricably linked to a tragic incident that took place twelve years earlier during Walpurgis Night, when evil forces reached their peak. As the line between control and obsession blurs, the dark rituals begin taking a heavy psychological and physical toll on everyone involved. Minase comes to understand that he is merely a pawn in a larger, sinister plot to resurrect ancient dark powers. Upon breaking free from the book's psychological hold, he recognizes the catastrophic danger facing his school. Minase is forced to confront both the corruption within himself and the malevolent cult controlling the academy. In a desperate race against time, he fights to undo the dark magic and escape the nightmare he helped unleash.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Bible Black revolves around high school student Yuuki Minase, who discovers a hidden dark grimoire on school grounds. What starts as an exploration of forbidden magic quickly spirals into a web of occult secrets, secret societies, and ancient curses tied to the school's past. The narrative explores themes of temptation, power, and redemption as the protagonist struggles against the sinister forces attempting to control him.

story_structure.climax: The full extent of the book's evil origin and the truth of the previous Walpurgis Night are unveiled, snapping Minase back to his senses as the sinister plot reaches its peak.
story_structure.conflict: As Minase begins practicing the dark arts for personal benefit, he becomes increasingly enticed by their dark power, unaware of the insidious forces at play.
story_structure.resolution: Recognizing the gravity of his actions, Minase struggles to break free from the dark influence and find a way out of the nightmare he helped unleash.
story_structure.introduction: High school student Minase discovers a mysterious black magic book hidden in a secluded room at his school.
story_structure.risingAction: Delving deeper into the occult, Minase and his inner circle experience growing consequences while the dark history of the book and a secretive incident from twelve years prior on Walpurgis Night begin to surface.
